definitionOfDone: At claim, re-measure the eight literal paths, imports/callers, hard-coded case counts and live ownership at current HEAD; adopt landed prerequisite records and stop for any newly owned or over-400 production path rather than expanding scope.

Red-first add one BEFORE, AFTER, and RACE production-surface case per named constant (12 cases, nonzero denominator) and assert exact code, layer, and zero admission. Fixtures must make the named guard the only possible refuser.

Divergence is explicit: PLAN uses a connected genuine approval.decide_intent affordance bound only to a foreign run; BUDGET uses valid seeded material with a one-hex digest near miss; CUTOVER drives the real store-refusal mapper with distinct expected-version versus field-invalid causes; GA binding uses core-minted grants whose family/campaign/claims are otherwise valid but whose generation/work identity alone mismatches.

Focused security typecheck and scheduler-activation Vitest run standalone/unpiped and print Test Files 1 passed plus a nonzero Tests count. Run affected control-room/daemon/benchmark package legs separately where a production file changed; disclose broad-lane foreign red by path delta.

Mutation drills relax each named production guard one degree and delete one hostile case; the exact code/layer or CONSTANT#ARM denominator assertion must red. Prove restore for every exact mutated path and record the 12-case count.
taskRails: Own exactly the eight listed paths. Do not edit BOUNDARY_ROSTER; the final integrity/roster row owns the exported shape and all of its asserting consumers.
No new or restamped refusal vocabulary. Pin the refusing layer that owns the guard, not merely an unsuccessful result.
Keep service, mapper, UI admission, benchmark binding, and test fixtures separated; target 250 lines per production file and split before 400.
Preserve foreign WIP and commit only explicit owned pathspecs; no reset, stash, blanket add, or whole-tree cleanup.
